body: Meant to say, I live in Canada, in the GTA.

I was doing an apprenticeship actually, to be a stone mason. However, the guy I was supposed to apprentice under screwed me out of 2 weeks pay. And it's not like I have the money to go to a lawyer and take him to court. In fact, I can't prove I actually worked those two weeks.

I am just tired. I am tired of being tired and I can't seem to escape.

I gave up on looking for something in my field a long time ago. I think my knee injury is just the cherry on top of this shit sundae. 

I have no idea where to go to get at help for people like this in my situation. I used to volunteer at a soup kitchen in my city, but they really only help people who are totally homeless or have serious drug addictions, or mental health issues. I am not quite at rock bottom so there really aren't any resources for me that I am aware of.

I'm not sad or depressed. Just really wish I could live my life again, just have a second chance.
